extracted.name: Corpse reviver no. 2
extracted.description: Create this spooky sipper for a grown up Halloween party. It's a fresher, citrus-led drink from corpse reviver no.1, with a hearty hit of absinthe
ingredient_lines: strip of orange peel to serve
instruction_lines: Pour all of the ingredients into a cocktail shaker with a large handful of ice. Shake until the outside feels cold and frosty.
Strain into a chilled coupe or martini glass. Garnish with a strip of orange peel.
